pages.Effects:
{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Game Mechanics}} '''Effects''' are certain conditions and modifiers that impact gameplay in various ways. These effects are viewable on the [[Galactic War|Galactic Map]]. The number of Effects and type vary by [[Biome]], [[Factions|Faction]], and [[Difficulty]]. ==Weapons Experimentation/Arsenal Augmentation== Occasionally, [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]] High Command makes certain [[Stratagems]] available for [[Helldiver]]s to deploy with as an additional mission standard-issue stratagem. These augmentations are purely additive and do not take up a slot on a Helldiver's Stratagem loadout. == Democracy Space Station == The [[Democracy Space Station]] can provide a Helldiver-funded "Tactical Action" in addition to the Liberation Campaign boosting "Operational Support" to whichever planet is being orbited.
{{DSS Action|Eagle Storm}} {{DSS Action|Orbital Blockade}} {{DSS Action|Heavy Ordnance Distribution}}
{{DSS Action|Effects}}
==Environmental Conditions== Environmental conditions refer to geophysical events that influence a [[Planets and Sectors|Planet's]] environment, experienced throughout [[missions]]. * {{Environmental Conditions|Acid Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Blizzards}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Extreme Cold}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Fire Tornados}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Ion Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Meteor Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Rainstorms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Sandstorms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Thick Fog}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Tremors}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Volcanic Activity}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Heavy Gloom Shroud}} * '''Moderate Gloom Blanket:''' The Gloom covers this planet completely, obstructing a variety of logistical operations. Extraction times are increased by 30 seconds and Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 20%. * '''Light Gloom Cover:''' Gloom particles interfere with landing Pelicans, increasing extraction times by 20 seconds. * '''[[Hive World|Gloom Source]]:''' This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging. Total Reinforcements are reduced by 20%, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30%, and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%. ===Operational Effects=== Sometimes, during certain events or Major Orders, some, if not all planets may gain an extra effect/modifier, available on all difficulties. * '''Orbital Fluctuations:''' All Orbital Stratagems have an increased cooldown. ''(not to be confused with the Operation Modifier with the same name, this effect only affects [[Stratagems|Orbital Stratagems]])'' * '''Medical Supply Strain:''' Number of stims each Helldiver deploys with decreased by 1. * '''Pilot Shortage:''' Extraction takes 30 additional seconds. * '''Slower Eagle Rearm:''' Eagle Rearm time is 25% slower. ==Operation Modifiers== Operation Modifiers are added obstacles that Helldivers must handle on the battlefield. A single Modifier will appear on {{Difficulty|5}}, increasing to two at {{Difficulty|8}}. Operation Modifiers do not appear on planets undergoing a [[Second Galactic War Mechanics#Defense Campaigns|Defense Campaign.]] ===General=== *[[Complex Stratagem Plotting]] – Stratagem Call-in time increased by 50%. *[[Orbital Fluctuations]] – Stratagem cooldown increased by 25%. *[[Poor Intel]] – Objective locations are hidden. *[[Civilians and SEAF in Area]] - [[SEAF Soldier]] squads and [[Civilian|Civilians]] are both on the battlefield. (Event modifier only present in [[Biomes#City Biomes|Metropolis Biomes]]) ===Faction-Specific=== {{Terminid|text}} *[[Atmospheric Spores]] – Map obscured by Bug Spores. *[[Roving Shriekers]] - Flying Shrieker swarms traverse the battlefield. {{Automaton|text}} *[[Gunship Patrols]] - Flying Gunships patrol the battlefield. {{Illuminate|text}} *[[Leviathan Blockade]] - Flying Leviathan warships patrol the battlefield. ===Removed=== *[[AA Defenses]] – Stratagem slots reduced by 1. *[[Atmospheric Interference]] – Orbital Stratagems Scatter Increased. *[[Electronic Countermeasures]] – Stratagem Codes Scrambled. == Combatant Forces == Some planets or cities will have modifiers that affect the types of units that spawn, whether it be friendly units or enemy ones, with them either increasing the frequency of specific units, replacing certain units with unique variants, or having entirely unique units. '''{{Terminid|text}}''' * Subfactions: ** [[Predator Strain]] - Unique cunning variants of [[Predator Hunter|Hunters]] and [[Predator Stalker|Stalkers]] will appear. ** [[Rupture Strain]] - Unique burrowing variants of [[Rupture Warrior|Warriors]], [[Rupture Spewer|Spewers]] and [[Rupture Charger|Chargers]] will appear. ** [[Spore Burst Strain]] - Unique explosive variants of [[Spore Burst Scavenger|Scavengers]], [[Spore Burst Hunter|Hunter]]s and [[Spore Burst Warrior|Warriors]] will appear. ** [[Dragonroach|Dragonroaches]] - [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]] will be replaced with a unique flying enemy; the [[Dragonroach|Dragonroach.]] ** [[Hive Lord|Hive Lords]] - The colossal worm-like [[Hive Lord]] will appear. (Requires {{Difficulty|7}} or above.) '''{{Automaton|text}}''' * Subfactions: ** [[Jet Brigade]] - Unique [[Assault Raider]] units will appear alongside jetpack-equipped variants of [[Jet Brigade Trooper|Troopers]], [[Jet Brigade MG Raider|MG Raiders]], [[Jet Brigade Commissar|Commissars]], [[Jet Brigade Devastator|Devastators]], [[Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher|Hulk Scorchers]] and [[Jet Brigade Hulk Bruiser|Hulk Bruisers]]. ** [[Incineration Corps]] - Unique [[Conflagration Devastator]] and [[Hulk Firebomber]] units will appear alongside incendiary-wielding variants of [[Pyro Trooper|Troopers]], [[Incendiary Rocket Raider|Rocket Raiders]] and [[Incendiary MG Devastator|Heavy Devastators]]. ** [[Cyborg Legion|Cyborgs]] - Unique cyborg [[Agitator]], [[Radical]] and [[Vox Engine]] units will appear. * Enemy Divisions: ** Hulk Surge - [[Hulk|Hulk units]] will spawn with increased frequency. ** Heavy Armor Surge - [[Tank|Tanks]] and [[Strider|Striders]] will spawn with increased frequency. ** Devastator Surge - [[Devastator]] units will spawn with increased frequency. '''{{Illuminate|text}}''' * Subfaction: ** [[Appropriators]] - Unique [[Obtruder]], [[Veracitor]], and [[Gatekeeper]] units will appear. ** [[Vote Snatchers]] - Unique [[Wretch]] and [[Crusher]] units will appear * Enemy Division: ** [[Mindless Masses]] - [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]] units will spawn with increased frequency. ** [[Invasion Fleet]] - [[Voteless]], [[Overseer]], [[Crescent Overseer]], [[Elevated Overseer]], [[Fleshmob]], [[Watcher]], [[Harvester]] and [[Stingray]] units will spawn with increased frequency. '''{{Super Earth|text= Federation of Super Earth}} *Division: ** [[Heavy SEAF Presence]] - [[SEAF Soldier]]s will be deployed into mission areas via [[Pelican Shuttle|Pelican Shuttles]]. == Other Effects == === Armor Passives === [[Armor Passives]] are unique, player-specific abilities or enhancements that are tied to their corresponding body armors. Depending on the perk, different stat(s) will be affected, altering the way Helldivers can operate in the mission. === Boosters === Each Helldiver has the option to equip a [[Boosters|booster]] before deployment, which applies buff to the entire squad. Depending on the booster, it can alter a Helldiver's stats, certain pieces of equipment, or mission mechanics. === Status Effects === [[Status Effects]] are various status effects that can alter the Helldiver or their Enemies. These range to effects from the burning or gas effects of specific weaponry, to effects from stratagems, enemies, or environmental conditions. === Physical Conditions === [[Physical Conditions]] refer to adverse effects that a Helldiver may experience on the battlefield. These conditions can range from minor debuffs to being fatal if left untreated. Depending on the condition, it can be self-inflicted, caused by the environment, or applied by an enemy attack. pages.Atmospheric Interference:
{{Environmental Conditions|{{PAGENAME}}}} was an [[Operation_Modifiers|Operation Modifier]] in [[Helldivers 2]] exclusive to the [[Terminids|Terminid]] front. It reduced the accuracy of all [[:Category:Orbital Stratagems|Orbital Stratagems]] by adding a significant deviation to their trajectory.
== Details ==
Atmospheric Interference increases the spread of all Orbital Stratagem's trajectories. Without this modifier, Orbital Stratagems will always hit the location marked by the stratagem ball. With Atmospheric Interference, the actual target location will vary within a several meter radius around the beacon. Sustained barrages such as the [[Orbital Gatling Barrage]] and [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]] will not correct themselves over time and continue to fire at wherever the barrage began.

== Strategy ==
Because all Orbital Stratagems become less accurate, they cannot be reliably used in combat. The worst affected is the [[Orbital Precision Strike|Precision Strike]] as it has the smallest margin of error of any Orbital with only a single shot and a relatively small area of effect, and using it against even the massive [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]] with this modifier in play becomes a roll of the dice. Generally speaking, this modifier is less penalizing the wider an area that an Orbital affects.

The [[Orbital Laser]] and [[Orbital Railcannon Strike]] are only marginally affected by this modifier, as their initial target is subject to the same spread like all other orbitals. However, their ability to automatically track enemies is not affected, meaning that they see no real loss of performance.

As [[:Category:Hangar Stratagems|Eagle Stratagems]] remain unaffected by this modifier, they should be taken in the place of Orbitals where appropriate.


== Change History ==

Removed from the game.
}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Operation_Modifiers|Operation Modifier]], exclusive to the [[Terminids|Terminid]] front.

== Details ==
The Bug Spores has a number of effects which obstruct the intelligence acquisition of the mission map:
*Topography is heavily obscured.
*Enemy (Terminid) unit "blips" won't appear the minimap.
*[[Spawn Mechanics|Areas of Influence]] (AoI) become extremely difficult to make out due the blending colours, effectively rendering Bug Nests and other AoI-heat-zones completely invisible on the minimap.
**Even after destruction, the Bug Nests remain unmarked on the minimap.

Completing the [[LiDAR Station]] Optional Objective will place markers on the minimap for every point of interest; however, Terminid-units including [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]] remain hidden from the minimap.

pages.Roving Shriekers:
{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Operation Modifiers}}
{{WIP|Add Screenshots and add details}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Operation_Modifiers|Operation Modifier]] in [[Helldivers 2]]. This modifier impacts all missions within the operation.

== Details ==
Flying Shrieker Swarms traverse the battlefield.

== Tactical Information ==
* Shriekers lack any sort of armor and can be taken out by most weaponry.
** Energy-based laser weaponry, such as the [[LAS-5 Scythe]] and the [[LAS-98 Laser Cannon]], have extremely long range and instant damage, allowing them to easily track and damage Shriekers.
** Shotguns with spread, such as the [[SG-8 Punisher]] and the [[SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary]], can damage Shriekers at close to medium range.
** The [[AC-8 Autocannon]]'s flak ammo can be used to kill multiple Shriekers at any distance.
* The [[A/MG-43 Machine Gun Sentry]], [[A/G-16 Gatling Sentry]] , and [[ARC-3 Arc Thrower]] are effective at taking out swarms of Shriekers.
* Rocks or physical objects can be used to break line-of-sight from Shriekers, preventing them from attacking in the direction of said obstruction.
* Laying prone on the ground will make a Helldiver harder for Shriekers to hit.
* Killing a Shrieker in the middle of its dive attack will cause it to plummet directly towards the Helldiver that killed it. Helldivers are advised to move or dive to avoid a Shrieker's corpse from dealing unnecessary damage.

pages.Difficulty:
{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Game Mechanics}}
When selecting a [[Missions|Mission]] in [[Helldivers 2|''Helldivers 2'']] using the Galactic War console, a difficulty can be selected between level 1 {{Difficulty|1}} and level 10 {{Difficulty|10}}.

Each difficulty level offers a different set of missions. For example, some missions offered to the player on {{Difficulty|1}} are not offered on {{Difficulty|6}}. 

== Effects==
*The number of {{Currency|Medals}}, {{Currency|Requisition}}, and {{Currency|Experience}} you earn from a mission all depends on the difficulty you select. 
**Higher difficulty missions have increasing percentage multipliers for Requisition Slips and Experience, from +25% on {{Difficulty|3}} to +300% on {{Difficulty|10}}
**The Eradication Main Objective base-reward depends on the selected difficulty. Each difficulty affects the rewards by {{Currency|Experience|20|notext}} and {{Currency|Requisition|100|notext}}. E.g. {{Difficulty|6}} Eradication-mission rewards {{Currency|Experience|120|notext}} and {{Currency|Requisition|600|notext}}, and {{Difficulty|3}} rewards  {{Currency|Experience|60|notext}} and  {{Currency|Requisition|300|notext}}.
* Enemy forces are enhanced to increasingly lethal degrees.
**The number of enemies and the type of enemy both depend on the difficulty level set.
**The frequency of enemy patrol being [[Spawn Mechanics|spawned]] increases alongside the difficulty.
***In relation, the frequency of [[Democracy Space Station#Tactical Actions|DSS Eagle Strike]] and other tactical actions during missions decreases with increased difficulty.
*The number of [[Operation Modifiers]] present during the mission.
**One modifier is added on {{Difficulty|5}}.
**A second modifier is added on {{Difficulty|8}}.

* The number of Sub-Objectives required to complete a [[Main Objectives|Main Objective]] increases at higher difficulties.
* The number and size of enemy Outposts ([[Terminid Nest|Bug Nests]]/[[Automaton Outpost|Automaton Outposts]]/[[Illuminate Encampment|Illuminate Encampments]])
** Outpost spawning can vary quite drastically depending on a number of other factors as well, including biome, mission type, and [[Factions|faction]].

*The number of [[Optional Objectives]] increases at higher difficulties.
*Map size increases to accommodate the increased amount of Mission Objectives on the Expedition-mission. The size increase is lesser on the [[Super Earth Metropolis|Metropolis]] [[Biomes|biome]] maps.
**As difficulty increases once maximum map-size has been achieved, the Mission Objectives occupy spaces which otherwise might have had [[Minor Places of Interest]] being places upon.
*The number and type of {{Currency|Common||notext}} {{Currency|Rare||notext}} {{Currency|Super||notext}} [[Samples]] able to be found depends on the set difficulty.
**{{Currency|Common||notext}} Commons appear on all difficulties, while {{Currency|Rare||notext}} Rares first appear on {{Difficulty|4}}, and {{Currency|Super||notext}} Supers on {{Difficulty|6}} difficulty.
**The type of samples available during an operation can be confirmed on the Galactic War console when selecting an operation.

pages.Physical Conditions:
Physical Conditions are debuffs or buffs given to a [[Helldiver]] in [[Helldivers 2]]. 

== Types of Conditions ==
* Right Arm Broken
** Negatively affects Grenade and stratagem throwing distance.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/@the_takibo takibo]. (2024, March 25). [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-kENHq6hKwg Helldivers 2 - 51 HUGE Advanced Quick Tips That Will Make You A Better Helldiver (Hidden Mechanics)] (video). ''youtube.com''. </ref> 
** Negatively affects weapon accuracy and handling.

* Left Arm Broken
** Negatively affects weapon accuracy and handling.

* Left/Right Leg Broken
** Slows you down.
** Disables Sprinting.

* Torso Injury
** Causes bleeding.

* Slowed
** Caused by some foliage.
** Caused by barbed wire.
** Caused by EMS fields.

* Bleeding
** Lose all stamina and blood until you die.

* Drowning
** Happens after swimming in a deep enough body of water for four seconds.

* Burning
** Take damage over time.
** Being in the prone position removes burning. You can dive to be prone faster.

pages.Automaton Mine:
{{Infobox Hazard | title=Automaton Mine | image=Automaton_Mine.png | description=When stepped on by a creature or otherwise damaged, it explodes and damages anything nearby. | type=Automaton Hazards | locations= Automaton Missions }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (officially '''Contact Mine'''), is a red and black contact mine constructed by the {{Automatons|text}}. It is an [[Environmental Hazards|Environmental Hazard]] found scattered around perimeters of the Automaton occupied zones, such as [[Automaton Outpost|Outposts]] and most [[Minor Places of Interest]] {{Difficulty|7}} onwards. == Effect == When stepped on by a creature or otherwise damaged, it explodes and damages whatever is nearby. == Detailed Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data/attack|explosion|Cyborg_Mine}}
== Locations == This hazard can only be found on Automaton Missions. As mentioned above, mines may be expected near any specific landmark where Automatons have stationed defenders. Mines become increasingly common as difficulty rises, to the point that they may be discovered '''in open terrain'''. == Anatomy == [[File:Automaton_Mine_Stage_Two.png|thumb|alt=|Automaton mine with lights off, in second stage trigger. ]] The Automatons' mines are volatile enough that a detailed breakdown of their damage zones would be redundant. There is a two-stage trigger state. If you move close enough (1-2m) you can trigger the first stage and get the lights to shut off. [https://medal.tv/games/helldivers-2/clips/lEYldYTTE3UfF4n3a?invite=cr-MSw4OUosNDA4OTUzMzIw&v=28 Video evidence.] == Tactical Information == * Using the 'tag location' command while pointing one's reticle at a Contact mine will place a temporary marker above that mine and issue a generic "Danger" vocal call out. * It is extremely unlikely to survive stepping on a Contact Mine without the [[Democracy Protects]] or [[Fortified]] armor passive effect. ** A Fortified heavy armor such as the [[FS-11 Executioner]] will leave its wearer with roughly 1/3 of their health if they step on a mine while in perfect condition. ** Using the [[SH-32 Shield Generator Pack]] has the potential to negate the effect of one mine. This will fully drain the shield pack, necessitating a recharge period. * Automatons tend to place their mines in logical positions that impede traffic toward areas that [[Helldivers]] would find desirable. ** The alternative entrances of Heavy Outposts, Fortresses, and [[Detector Tower]] hills are all extremely likely to be mined. Areas adjacent to the primary entrances may also be mined. ** [[Colonies]] will often be mined at breaches in their outer wall. ** Alleyways and intersections may be mined inside of occupied [[Mega City|Mega Cities]] and Colonies. ** The smaller underground variant of the [[Bunker]] place of interest tends to be heavily mined on higher difficulties. * Automaton Mines are extremely sensitive to damage. Gunfire and explosions can detonate them easily. ** Beam weapons such as the [[LAS-5 Scythe|LAS-5]] are preferable for mine clearing due to their uninterrupted stream of damage and (hypothetically) infinite ammunition. ** Automaton forces will attempt to avoid stepping on their own mines, but may still pass close enough to be damaged by one if detonated by an outside force. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.300|changes= Fix * Fixed Automaton mines getting under ground after a nearby mine explodes }} {{Change History Update|1.000.000|changes= Initial release of the game or otherwise simply a placeholder section. }} == References == [[Category:Bot Hazards]] [[Category:Environmental Hazards]] {{Nav Mechanic}}

pages.Lava:
{{Infobox Hazard
| title=Lava
| image=Lava Lake.png
| description=Pools and rivers of molten lava, will ignite Helldivers upon contact
| type=Terrain
| locations= [[Magma Desert]], [[Automaton Megafactory]], [[Cyberstan Megafactory]]}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Environmental Hazards|Environmental Hazard]], found in abundance in [[Magma Desert]] planets, and occasionally in the form of concrete pits in [[Megafactory|Automaton Megafactory]] structures.

== Effect ==
* Anything coming into contact with lava will instantly ignite, dealing {{Damage|Fire|100 DPS|notext}} and constantly re-igniting entities until any contact with the lava ceases.
* Touching the lava will also deal a small amount of extra damage.

== Location ==
* Similarly to water on certain planets, lava can come in the form of lakes and seas, being found around the edges of mission areas and in large lakes separating large sections.
** Most of the time, these lakes will be large, requiring anything desiring to cross them to find an alternative route.
** Occasionally, {{Automaton}} [[Automaton|Automaton-built]] bridges can be found, allowing the lake to be crossed quickly and easily.
* Lava can also be found in the form of rivers, flowing across the surface and between crevices and rock formations.
** Rivers can easily be avoided by diving over them, as they are usually not very wide.
* Rarely, tiny lava pockets can be seen on the rocky surface of a planet, being on average not much bigger than a human.
* Occasionally, lava can be found in large concrete cutouts of the terrain on [[Megafactory]] structures.
** Tiny pockets on the surface may rarely also be seen.

== Tactical Information ==
* Walking over lava is not advised as the Helldiver will immediately be set on fire and take 100 damage per second, killing them in just around a second, depending on armor.
** As is standard for being set on fire, diving will immediately stop the fire. However when diving on lava, the Helldiver will be instantly re-ignited.
** The use of certain [[Armor]] with passives such as [[Inflammable]] and [[Acclimated]], and [[boosters]] such as the [[Vitality Enhancement]] booster can delay death by a few seconds.
* While vehicles can also cross over lava, usage of them on lava is also not advised, especially for longer periods of time.
** The [[M-102 Fast Reconnaissance Vehicle]] is not recommended  for crossing lava.
*** Once the FRV comes into contact with lava, the rubber tires will immediately catch on fire and explode, making any future steering extremely difficult.
*** The main body of the FRV will also catch on fire, exploding after about 10 seconds.
** Both the [[EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit]] and the [[EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit]] can be used to cross  smaller patches of lava such as rivers, but this will damage the exosuit. its legs in particular.
* Anything landing on lava that comes inside a Hellpod, such as Helldivers, emplacements, turrets and [[Support weapon]]s will not catch on fire as they are protected by the Hellpod.
* Enemies such as the {{Automaton}} [[Automaton Legion]] cannot pathfind over lava, so if they happen to spawn on an island surrounded by lava with no way off of it, they will be unable to move.
** Stuck Automatons may still shoot back if they spot the Helldiver.

'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are an unique feature of [[Magma Desert|Magma Deserts]]. They are an [[Environmental Hazards|Environmental Hazard]].

== Effect ==
Lava Geysers are small to medium-sized bits of terrain, with a pocket of lava in the middle. These often explode, which is safe at a distance.

* Usually, these geysers are calm, being little more than a rock.
* Every ~20 seconds though, the ground will begin to shake and the core of the geyser will begin to bubble with lava.
* After a few seconds of bubbling, the geyser will explode, spurting out lava and molten rocks, setting anything standing too close on fire and launching them away with a shockwave, which can sometimes prove deadly.

== Location ==
Lava geysers can be found on [[Magma Desert]]s on the ground, usually near streams of [[Lava]] and occasionally inside places of interest.

pages.Shrub:
{{Infobox Hazard
| title = Shrub
| image = Caustic Badlands Shrub.png
| description = Slows any creature or Helldiver that moves through it.
| type = Flora
| locations = All Biomes except Extreme Cold
}}
'''Shrubs''', or '''Ferns''' depending on the [[Biomes|Biome]], are hindering plants of various shapes and colors.

== Effect ==

Both creatures and Helldivers become slower whilst walking through a Fern or Shrub. However, this is greatly negated for Helldivers when using the [[Muscle Enhancement]] [[Boosters|Booster]].

Additionally, when a Helldiver is crouching or prone inside of a Shrub, it reduces detection range from enemies, allowing enemy patrols to stroll right past a Helldiver. A black vignette surrounds the screen to confirm that you are concealed. Though, since hiding in a Fern or Shrub only hides a Helldiver visually, unsuppressed weapons and/or standing too close to the enemy can still alert them to your position.

== Location ==

Ferns and Shrubs can be found in any Biome excluding [[Extreme Cold]] biomes; specifically [[Boneyard]], [[Icy Glaciers]], and [[Moon]].
